The rightmost elephant has a plastic-like, overly smooth texture compared to the detailed wrinkling of the others. Additionally, the zebra's front leg joints appear anatomically ambiguous and bulbous. While the lighting and dust effects are convincing, these structural defects reduce the authenticity score.
